meanings.tr: çağlayan, şelale; ardı ardına gelen seri
meanings.en: a small waterfall or a series of things happening in succession
meanings.exampleEn: A cascade of water tumbled down the rocks.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayalardan aşağıya bir çağlayan döküldü.

meanings.en: the actors in a play or film
meanings.exampleEn: The entire cast gathered on stage for the final bow.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm oyuncu kadrosu son selam için sahnede toplandı.

meanings.en: in a relaxed or informal way
meanings.exampleEn: He casually mentioned that he was leaving the company.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketten ayrılacağını rahatça, sıradan bir şekilde söyledi.

meanings.en: a complete list of items, often with details
meanings.exampleEn: She flipped through the catalog to find a new sofa.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni bir kanepe bulmak için kataloğu karıştırdı.

meanings.en: something that causes or speeds up a change
meanings.exampleEn: The protest became a catalyst for political reform.
meanings.exampleTr: Protesto, siyasi reform için bir katalizör oldu.

meanings.en: a sudden disaster causing great damage
meanings.exampleEn: The earthquake was a catastrophe for the entire region.
meanings.exampleTr: Deprem, tüm bölge için bir felaketti.

meanings.en: extremely harmful or disastrous
meanings.exampleEn: The flood had a catastrophic effect on local farms.
meanings.exampleTr: Sel, yerel çiftliklerde yıkıcı bir etki yarattı.

meanings.en: pleasing and easy to remember
meanings.exampleEn: The advert had a catchy tune that I couldn't forget.
meanings.exampleTr: Reklamın unutamadığım akılda kalıcı bir melodisi vardı.

meanings.en: the act of sorting things into groups
meanings.exampleEn: The categorization of the books made them easy to find.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitapların sınıflandırılması onları bulmayı kolaylaştırdı.

meanings.en: the business of providing food at events
meanings.exampleEn: They hired a company for the wedding catering.
meanings.exampleTr: Düğün yemek hizmeti için bir şirketle anlaştılar.

meanings.en: a large and important Christian church
meanings.exampleEn: Tourists admired the stained glass in the old cathedral.
meanings.exampleTr: Turistler eski katedraldeki vitrayları hayranlıkla izledi.

meanings.en: the reason something happens
meanings.exampleEn: The police are investigating the cause of the fire.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis yangının nedenini araştırıyor.

meanings.en: to stop happening or doing something
meanings.exampleEn: The factory will cease production at the end of the month.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika ay sonunda üretimi durduracak.

meanings.en: the upper inside surface of a room
meanings.exampleEn: A spider crawled across the white ceiling.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir örümcek beyaz tavanın üzerinde gezindi.

meanings.en: an underground room, often for storage
meanings.exampleEn: They kept the wine in a cool, dark cellar.
meanings.exampleTr: Şarabı serin, karanlık bir mahzende tuttular.

meanings.en: a person who plays the cello
meanings.exampleEn: The cellist played a beautiful solo at the concert.
meanings.exampleTr: Viyolonselci konserde güzel bir solo çaldı.

meanings.en: a large stringed instrument played with a bow
meanings.exampleEn: She has been learning to play the cello for two years.
meanings.exampleTr: İki yıldır viyolonsel çalmayı öğreniyor.

meanings.en: a place where dead people are buried
meanings.exampleEn: They visited the cemetery to lay flowers on the grave.
meanings.exampleTr: Mezara çiçek bırakmak için mezarlığı ziyaret ettiler.

meanings.en: a temperature scale where water freezes at 0 and boils at 100
meanings.exampleEn: The temperature reached forty degrees centigrade today.
meanings.exampleTr: Bugün sıcaklık kırk santigrat dereceye ulaştı.

meanings.en: an official document proving something
meanings.exampleEn: She received a certificate after completing the course.
meanings.exampleTr: Kursu tamamladıktan sonra bir sertifika aldı.

meanings.en: the official approval that something meets a standard
meanings.exampleEn: The product needs certification before it can be sold.
meanings.exampleTr: Ürünün satılabilmesi için belgelendirme gerekiyor.

meanings.en: to officially state that something is true or valid
meanings.exampleEn: A doctor must certify that the patient is fit to work.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir doktor, hastanın çalışmaya uygun olduğunu belgelemelidir.

meanings.en: a high government official or head of a university
meanings.exampleEn: The German chancellor addressed the nation last night.
meanings.exampleTr: Alman şansölyesi dün gece ulusa seslendi.

meanings.en: in a state of complete disorder
meanings.exampleEn: The morning rush hour was absolutely chaotic.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabah trafiği tamamen kaotikti.

meanings.en: typical of a particular person or thing
meanings.exampleEn: He answered with his characteristic sense of humor.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendine özgü mizah anlayışıyla cevap verdi.

meanings.en: very pleasant and attractive
meanings.exampleEn: We stayed in a charming little village in the hills.
meanings.exampleTr: Tepelerdeki sevimli, küçük bir köyde kaldık.

meanings.en: to act dishonestly to gain an advantage
meanings.exampleEn: He was caught trying to cheat on the exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Sınavda kopya çekmeye çalışırken yakalandı.

meanings.en: a place where people or vehicles are inspected
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers stopped every car at the checkpoint.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler kontrol noktasında her arabayı durdurdu.

meanings.en: rude or disrespectful in an amusing way
meanings.exampleEn: The cheeky boy stuck out his tongue at the teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: Arsız çocuk öğretmene dilini çıkardı.

meanings.en: in a happy and positive way
meanings.exampleEn: She cheerfully greeted everyone at the door.
meanings.exampleTr: Kapıda herkesi neşeyle karşıladı.

meanings.en: the quality of being happy and positive
meanings.exampleEn: Her cheerfulness lifted everyone's mood at work.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun neşesi iş yerinde herkesin moralini yükseltti.

meanings.en: the treatment of disease, especially cancer, with drugs
meanings.exampleEn: She started chemotherapy soon after her diagnosis.
meanings.exampleTr: Teşhisin ardından kısa süre sonra kemoterapiye başladı.

meanings.tr: değer verilen, çok sevilen, el üstünde tutulan
meanings.en: loved and valued very deeply
meanings.exampleEn: These photographs are among my most cherished possessions.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu fotoğraflar en çok değer verdiğim eşyalarım arasında.

meanings.en: a small round red or black fruit
meanings.exampleEn: She placed a single cherry on top of the cake.
meanings.exampleTr: Pastanın üzerine tek bir kiraz koydu.

meanings.en: to crush food with the teeth before swallowing
meanings.exampleEn: You should chew your food slowly and carefully.
meanings.exampleTr: Yiyeceğini yavaş ve dikkatlice çiğnemelisin.

meanings.en: silly and immature, like a child
meanings.exampleEn: Stop being so childish and apologize to her.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar çocukça davranmayı bırak ve ondan özür dile.

meanings.en: a structure that carries smoke away from a fire
meanings.exampleEn: Smoke rose gently from the cottage chimney.
meanings.exampleTr: Kulübenin bacasından usulca duman yükseldi.

meanings.en: a small piece broken off something, or a microchip
meanings.exampleEn: There was a small chip on the edge of the plate.
meanings.exampleTr: Tabağın kenarında küçük bir çentik vardı.

meanings.en: to cut something into pieces with sharp blows
meanings.exampleEn: Please chop the onions finely for the sauce.
meanings.exampleTr: Sos için soğanları ince ince doğra.

meanings.en: a thick, solid piece of something
meanings.exampleEn: He broke off a chunk of bread and ate it.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir parça ekmek kopardı ve yedi.

meanings.en: a complete path for an electric current
meanings.exampleEn: A faulty circuit caused the power to go out.
meanings.exampleTr: Arızalı bir devre elektriğin kesilmesine neden oldu.

meanings.en: a system of electrical circuits
meanings.exampleEn: The phone's delicate circuitry was damaged by water.
meanings.exampleTr: Telefonun hassas devre sistemi sudan zarar gördü.

meanings.en: a fact or condition affecting a situation
meanings.exampleEn: Under no circumstance should you open this door.
meanings.exampleTr: Hiçbir koşulda bu kapıyı açmamalısın.

meanings.en: happening across an entire city
meanings.exampleEn: The council launched a citywide recycling program.
meanings.exampleTr: Belediye şehir çapında bir geri dönüşüm programı başlattı.

meanings.en: a shellfish with two shells joined together
meanings.exampleEn: We dug for clams along the sandy beach.
meanings.exampleTr: Kumlu sahil boyunca deniz tarağı için kazdık.

meanings.en: to hit your hands together to show approval
meanings.exampleEn: The audience began to clap when the show ended.
meanings.exampleTr: Gösteri bittiğinde seyirci alkışlamaya başladı.

meanings.en: the arrangement of things into groups by type
meanings.exampleEn: The classification of animals helps scientists study them.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayvanların sınıflandırılması bilim insanlarının onları incelemesine yardımcı olur.

meanings.en: the quality of being easy to see or understand
meanings.exampleEn: The clearness of the water let us see the fish below.
meanings.exampleTr: Suyun berraklığı, aşağıdaki balıkları görmemizi sağladı.

meanings.en: relating to office or paperwork tasks
meanings.exampleEn: Her job involved mostly clerical work like filing.
meanings.exampleTr: İşi çoğunlukla dosyalama gibi büro işlerini içeriyordu.

meanings.en: long-term changes in the Earth's weather patterns
meanings.exampleEn: Climate change is causing sea levels to rise.
meanings.exampleTr: İklim değişikliği deniz seviyelerinin yükselmesine neden oluyor.

meanings.en: to block something so nothing can pass through
meanings.exampleEn: Fallen leaves can clog the gutters in autumn.
meanings.exampleTr: Düşen yapraklar sonbaharda oluğu tıkayabilir.

meanings.en: the act of closing something permanently
meanings.exampleEn: The closure of the factory left many people jobless.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrikanın kapanması birçok insanı işsiz bıraktı.

meanings.en: the things people wear to cover the body
meanings.exampleEn: Bring warm clothing for the mountain hike.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağ yürüyüşü için kalın giysiler getir.

meanings.en: moving awkwardly and often dropping things
meanings.exampleEn: He was so clumsy that he knocked over the vase.
meanings.exampleTr: O kadar sakardı ki vazoyu devirdi.

meanings.en: the activity of training or instructing someone
meanings.exampleEn: She received personal coaching to improve her tennis.
meanings.exampleTr: Tenisini geliştirmek için kişisel koçluk aldı.

meanings.en: a union of groups or parties for a common goal
meanings.exampleEn: The two parties formed a coalition to win the vote.
meanings.exampleTr: İki parti oylamayı kazanmak için bir koalisyon kurdu.

meanings.en: rough in texture or not fine
meanings.exampleEn: The blanket was made of coarse, scratchy wool.
meanings.exampleTr: Battaniye kaba, kaşındıran yünden yapılmıştı.

meanings.en: the outline of a coast where land meets the sea
meanings.exampleEn: The rugged coastline stretched for miles.
meanings.exampleTr: Engebeli sahil şeridi kilometrelerce uzanıyordu.

meanings.en: a mixed alcoholic drink
meanings.exampleEn: The bartender made a refreshing fruit cocktail.
meanings.exampleTr: Barmen ferahlatıcı bir meyveli kokteyl hazırladı.

meanings.en: a brown powder made from cacao beans, used in chocolate
meanings.exampleEn: She warmed a cup of cocoa on the cold evening.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğuk akşamda bir fincan kakao ısıttı.

meanings.en: a large brown tropical fruit with white flesh
meanings.exampleEn: He cracked open a coconut to drink the milk inside.
meanings.exampleTr: İçindeki suyu içmek için bir hindistan cevizini kırdı.

meanings.en: the quality of being logical and well connected
meanings.exampleEn: The essay lacked coherence and was hard to follow.
meanings.exampleTr: Makalede tutarlılık yoktu ve takip etmesi zordu.

meanings.en: to happen at the same time as something else
meanings.exampleEn: My holiday happened to coincide with the festival.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatilim tesadüfen festivalle aynı zamana denk geldi.

meanings.en: a chance occurrence of events at the same time
meanings.exampleEn: It was a pure coincidence that we met at the airport.
meanings.exampleTr: Havaalanında karşılaşmamız tamamen bir tesadüftü.

meanings.en: a person who collects things as a hobby or job
meanings.exampleEn: He is a keen collector of old coins.
meanings.exampleTr: O, hevesli bir eski para koleksiyoncusudur.

meanings.en: words that frequently appear together
meanings.exampleEn: 'Strong coffee' is a common collocation in English.
meanings.exampleTr: 'Strong coffee', İngilizcede yaygın bir eşdizimdir.

meanings.tr: iki nokta üst üste; kalın bağırsak
meanings.en: the punctuation mark (:); also part of the intestine
meanings.exampleEn: Use a colon before a list of items.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir öğe listesinden önce iki nokta üst üste kullanın.

meanings.en: relating to a colony or the period of colonization
meanings.exampleEn: The town has many beautiful colonial buildings.
meanings.exampleTr: Kasabada birçok güzel sömürge dönemi binası var.

meanings.en: a deep state of unconsciousness
meanings.exampleEn: After the accident, she fell into a coma for weeks.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazadan sonra haftalarca komaya girdi.

meanings.en: in a relaxed and pleasant way
meanings.exampleEn: She settled comfortably into the soft armchair.
meanings.exampleTr: Yumuşak koltuğa rahatça yerleşti.
